mechanism: For lambda0 and explicitly bounded16-unit cost tables, scale costs to bits and pack23costbits+9circular-positionbits in a2560xU32 range-min table. Split queries at the circular boundary and convert stamps to relative lengths before comparing, preserving absolute tie order. All ineligible cases use originalSFsolve64; SFheavy seed/prefix unchanged.
difference_from_old_work: A representation change in the ordinary SF solver, not altered prices or larger query groups. The guard checks lambda, span and cost-table bounds/divisibility. Cost/state footprint drops32KiBallocated/20KiBused to10KiB. Range-boundary model precedes realtoken/encoder checks; no inferred speed from size.
